# Suggested GitHub repository settings

Copy into **GitHub → Repository → About** (description):

```
Privacy-first Windows browser (Rust + WebView2). Local Truth Engine with Ollama + Qdrant. Unified compositor shell. No cloud telemetry.
```

Suggested topics: `browser`, `rust`, `webview2`, `privacy`, `ollama`, `qdrant`, `windows`

Do **not** reference unrelated private applications, gambling, or poker products in the public About field.

See [docs/REPOSITORY_SCOPE.md](../docs/REPOSITORY_SCOPE.md).
